generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output  = "../app/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Purchase {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  quantity Int @default(1)
  totalCents String
  status String @default("PENDING")
  purchasedAt DateTime @default(now())
  deletedAt DateTime?
}

model Payout {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  amountCents Int
  status String @default("HELD")
  releasedAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @unique
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  deletedAt DateTime?
}

model User {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  email String @unique
  displayName String
  isVendor Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  listingId Int
  listings Listing[]
  purchaseId Int
  purchases Purchase[]
  deletedAt DateTime?
  @@index([listingId])
}

model Listing {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  title String
  description String?
  priceCents Int
  stock Int @default(1)
  status String @default("ACTIVE")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  purchaseId Int
  purchases Purchase[]
  deletedAt DateTime?
}
